text:
sylvie_pm: Short sync - want a crisp contract for Private packaging v1 before we lock dates. Focus: customer-managed networking, non-disruptive upgrades, and a signed airgap story. Key unknowns: acceptable rollback MTTR, how to surface maintenance windows, and what counts as a canary pass.

ken_eng: Proposal: MUST for v1 = signed bundle + integrity check, `egress.natPersist` mode to preserve LB IPs, and an upgrade dry-run flag that performs validation without committing state. Dry-run should run migration hooks and report diffs.

zara_field: Field input: netops wants an explicit maintenance-window banner + webhook callback for approval. They also want a small netops-friendly manifest showing required firewall rules and BGP peer hints.

otto_sre: For rollback/MTTR: guarantee automated revert path that completes within 30 minutes for common failure classes (leader loss, DB migration fail, LB reclaim). We require KV snapshot + local export before any upgrade. Add a smoke probe immediately after upgrade to assert egress-IP unchanged.

ken_eng: Implementation notes: signed bundle = bundle.tar + bundle.sig verified via embedded public key. dry-run = `redwoodctl upgrade --dry-run --out=report.json`. natPersist will try to rebind LB IP via provider API or mark for manual reconcile if provider doesn't support claim.

zara_field: Customers also asked for a minimal "compatibility card" downloadable from console (kernel, CNI, kube version, recommended MTU), and a simple green/yellow/red preflight result they can give to their netops team.

otto_sre: Canary definition: two wave strategy. Wave A = internal test + 1 friendly customer for 7 days (zero error regression), Wave B = second beta for 7 days with telemetry off if requested. Both waves must show <3% error delta and egress-ip persistence.

sylvie_pm: Good. Risks: airgapped sites that block signature verification -> add a manual-signing workflow. LB providers that reclaim IPs on recreate -> provide manual reconcile CLI and doc. Telemetry blocked -> require telemetry opt-out and clear offline support.

ken_eng: Preflight checks to ship: outbound connectivity (or proxy config), disk, k8s version, CNI plugin, LB claim test, signature verifier (or manual-sig flag). Each failure returns one remediation line.

zara_field: I'll arrange two beta customers and own comms. target: onboard wave A in 6 weeks. Need field eng on-call during cutovers.

otto_sre: I'll draft the rollback playbook and the canary metrics dashboard. Include automated snapshot commands in runbook: `redwoodctl snapshot --local ./snap.tar` and `redwoodctl restore --from ./snap.tar`.

release-bot: NOTE: created ticket RW-PRIV-2110: "packaging orchestration: signed-bundle, dry-run, natPersist, canary waves" assigned to private-packaging.

sylvie_pm: Action items: ken = implement dry-run + natPersist prototype by next Tue; otto = rollback runbook + CI smoke jobs by EOW; zara = confirm beta customers and maintenance windows next Fri. I'll update roadmap and mark epic "launch-gates: signed-airgap, dry-run, canary-waves". Thanks. :thumbsup:
